title: Delete PointsPopupWidget or give it a real call site
why: grep across lib/ and test/ shows PointsPopupWidget is only ever referenced from its own test file (points_display_widget_test.dart) -- it is never instantiated by any screen (not learning_screen.dart, not bulk_mark_screen.dart, nowhere completion-triggered popups would plausibly live). It's fully-formed, styled, and tested code that the app never actually shows to a user.
recommendation: Either remove PointsPopupWidget and its test, or wire it into the completion-celebration flow it was clearly built for (alongside AchievementUnlockCelebration) and add a widget test proving it renders from a real screen.
acceptance_criteria: PointsPopupWidget is either deleted (with its test) or has at least one production call site exercised by a widget test
